meta.title: Lightless Daybreak
meta.description: Slay the shadows of the past and shed light upon the silence.

units.rawText: Eosphorus... It was him all along...
units.displayText: Eosphorus... It was him all along...

units.rawText: I fear it may trace back a long time ago...

units.rawText: —What are you?

God

units.rawText: I am...

units.rawText: Professor, come to me, quickly!
units.displayText: Professor, come to me, quickly!

spans.text: Professor, come to me, quickly!

units.rawText: Before I realize, the dispersed mist is once again trapping us inside. Its shape changes with the direction of the wind, gradually morphing into others' appearances from my memory.
units.displayText: Before I realize, the dispersed mist is once again trapping us inside. Its shape changes with the direction of the wind, gradually morphing into others' appearances from my memory.

spans.text: Before I realize, the dispersed mist is once again trapping us inside. Its shape changes with the direction of the wind, gradually morphing into others' appearances from my memory.

units.rawText: Eosphorus...
units.displayText: Eosphorus...

spans.text: Eosphorus...

units.displayText: Although he gazes upon us, his pupils show nothing. The overpowering presence approaches as he slowly walks toward us.

spans.text: Although he gazes upon us, his pupils show nothing. The overpowering presence approaches as he slowly walks toward us.

units.rawText: Prepare to meet your end.
units.displayText: Prepare to meet your end.

spans.text: Prepare to meet your end.

units.rawText: ...You're not him.
units.displayText: ...You're not him.

spans.text: ...You're not him.

units.displayText: My gaze fixes on his eyes, and I grip the gun in my hands ever so tighter.

spans.text: My gaze fixes on his eyes, and I grip the gun in my hands ever so tighter.

units.rawText: You're just an imposter, wearing his face. With your core destroyed, your operands and abilities pale in comparison to the real Eosphorus—barely 10% of his strength.
units.displayText: You're just an imposter, wearing his face. With your core destroyed, your operands and abilities pale in comparison to the real Eosphorus—barely 10% of his strength.

spans.text: Outnumbered... I don't think so.

units.rawText: <size=40>BOOM—</size>
units.displayText: BOOM—

units.displayText: A bombardment rains down the battlefield, obliterating the replicators, returning them back into Entropic Liquid.

spans.text: A bombardment rains down the battlefield, obliterating the replicators, returning them back into Entropic Liquid.

units.rawText: Tsk... It's not as effective as I'd anticipated.

spans.text: Tsk... It's not as effective as I'd anticipated.

units.rawText: We're too far from them. The last shot was pretty good I'd say.

spans.text: Croque! Simo! How did you get over here?

units.rawText: Bonneville reached out to us, passing along the coordinates while we waited for orders at the backline. Then, we moved out.

units.rawText: ...And it's not just the two of us.
units.displayText: ...And it's not just the two of us.

spans.text: ...And it's not just the two of us.

units.rawText: I didn't expect for there to be such a commotion... replicators? Eww, that's disgusting.
units.displayText: I didn't expect for there to be such a commotion... replicators? Eww, that's disgusting.

spans.text: Aki! Centaureissi! Your timing is impeccable!

units.rawText: The four join us, readying themselves for battle. At the same time, the shattered Entropic group reforms, reshaping itself into the Exiles from my memory. Fury burns brightly in everyone's gaze.
units.displayText: The four join us, readying themselves for battle. At the same time, the shattered Entropic group reforms, reshaping itself into the Exiles from my memory. Fury burns brightly in everyone's gaze.

spans.text: ...Ahem! And here goes, the original 1st-gen Exile Team with all of their combatants.

units.rawText: No worries, Professor. We're far more than who we used to be.
units.displayText: No worries, Professor. We're far more than who we used to be.

spans.text: No worries, Professor. We're far more than who we used to be.

units.rawText: Yep, this is a perfect test to show how much I've improved.
units.displayText: Yep, this is a perfect test to show how much I've improved.

spans.text: Yep, this is a perfect test to show how much I've improved.

units.displayText: Roger!

units.displayText: Sol...

spans.text: Sol...

units.displayText: Yo! Long time no see, Persicaria.

spans.text: Yo! Long time no see, Persicaria.

units.displayText: The familiar voice shakes Persicaria, as if her time is rewound to that afternoon when they first met. Her hand rests on the hilt of her longsword, yet hesitation impedes her from drawing it.

spans.text: The familiar voice shakes Persicaria, as if her time is rewound to that afternoon when they first met. Her hand rests on the hilt of her longsword, yet hesitation impedes her from drawing it.

units.displayText: Persicaria, that's not the real Sol. It's just an illusion fabricated from my memory.

spans.text: Persicaria, that's not the real Sol. It's just an illusion fabricated from my memory.

units.rawText: ...I know.
units.displayText: ...I know.

spans.text: ...I know.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll steels her resolve, unsheathing her sword and positioning herself in front of me.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll steels her resolve, unsheathing her sword and positioning herself in front of me.

units.displayText: Leave her to me. I'll wrap it up quickly and return to your side soon after.

spans.text: Leave her to me. I'll wrap it up quickly and return to your side soon after.

units.rawText: Before that, Sangoma, could I count on you to hold off Eosphorus?

units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll glances for a moment. She lets out a sigh and puts the giant scythe on her back.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll glances for a moment. She lets out a sigh and puts the giant scythe on her back.

units.rawText: Fine. I don't know how much I can do, but I'll accept your mission, as impossible as it may be for now.
units.displayText: Fine. I don't know how much I can do, but I'll accept your mission, as impossible as it may be for now.

units.rawText: You owe me for this one.
units.displayText: You owe me for this one.

spans.text: You owe me for this one.

units.rawText: You overestimate yourself.
units.displayText: You overestimate yourself.

spans.text: You overestimate yourself.

units.rawText: ...You don't know if you never try!
units.displayText: ...You don't know if you never try!

spans.text: ...You don't know if you never try!

units.displayText: She raises her giant scythe, pointing it at the imposter, and softly licks the blood that stains the corner of her mouth.

spans.text: She raises her giant scythe, pointing it at the imposter, and softly licks the blood that stains the corner of her mouth.

units.displayText: Persicaria...

units.rawText: Sangoma, let's head on out.

units.rawText: Sure.
units.displayText: Sure.

spans.text: Sure.

units.displayText: Hey!

spans.text: Wowzers, you're really blunt with your words!

units.rawText: But that's exactly why I look up to you.
units.displayText: But that's exactly why I look up to you.

spans.text: But that's exactly why I look up to you.

units.rawText: Eh?
units.displayText: Eh?

spans.text: Eh?

units.rawText: Before Persicaria can react, a precise slash strikes again, leaving her no space to think about the words she just heard...
units.displayText: Before Persicaria can react, a precise slash strikes again, leaving her no space to think about the words she just heard...

spans.text: Before Persicaria can react, a precise slash strikes again, leaving her no space to think about the words she just heard...

units.rawText: Hah... Hah...!
units.displayText: Hah... Hah...!

spans.text: Hah... Hah...!

units.rawText: Sangoma supports herself with her giant scythe, struggling to her feet. Although she still stands, her body is covered in wounds and she has no strength left to fight.
units.displayText: Sangoma supports herself with her giant scythe, struggling to her feet. Although she still stands, her body is covered in wounds and she has no strength left to fight.

spans.text: Sangoma supports herself with her giant scythe, struggling to her feet. Although she still stands, her body is covered in wounds and she has no strength left to fight.

units.rawText: You're surely capable, to be able to stand before me for so long.
units.displayText: You're surely capable, to be able to stand before me for so long.

spans.text: You're surely capable, to be able to stand before me for so long.

units.rawText: ...But it's time for you to exit the stage.
units.displayText: ...But it's time for you to exit the stage.

spans.text: ...But it's time for you to exit the stage.

units.rawText: With a wave of Eosphorus' hand, a whirlwind of operands surges toward Sangoma, hurling her away as effortlessly as a gust would lift a sheet of paper.
units.displayText: With a wave of Eosphorus' hand, a whirlwind of operands surges toward Sangoma, hurling her away as effortlessly as a gust would lift a sheet of paper.

spans.text: With a wave of Eosphorus' hand, a whirlwind of operands surges toward Sangoma, hurling her away as effortlessly as a gust would lift a sheet of paper.

units.rawText: Gah!
units.displayText: Gah!

spans.text: Gah!

units.rawText: Sangoma!
units.displayText: Sangoma!

spans.text: Sangoma!

units.rawText: <cmdr>, you should worry for yourself before anyone else.
units.displayText: {교수}, you should worry for yourself before anyone else.

spans.text: , you should worry for yourself before anyone else.

units.rawText: Another attack surges from Eosphorus. Though it was offhanded strike meant only to intimidate, I barely manage to evade it and suffer damage from the impact.
units.displayText: Another attack surges from Eosphorus. Though it was offhanded strike meant only to intimidate, I barely manage to evade it and suffer damage from the impact.

spans.text: Another attack surges from Eosphorus. Though it was offhanded strike meant only to intimidate, I barely manage to evade it and suffer damage from the impact.

units.rawText: Red operands drip slowly, clouding my vision. The mastermind turns toward me, his golden gaze radiating an oppressive presence that feels as though it could grind me to dust.
units.displayText: Red operands drip slowly, clouding my vision. The mastermind turns toward me, his golden gaze radiating an oppressive presence that feels as though it could grind me to dust.

spans.text: Red operands drip slowly, clouding my vision. The mastermind turns toward me, his golden gaze radiating an oppressive presence that feels as though it could grind me to dust.

units.rawText: ...You surpass my expectations, time and time again, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: ...You surpass my expectations, time and time again, {교수}.

spans.text: ...You surpass my expectations, time and time again,

units.rawText: But this time is different. I have the last piece of the puzzle. You no longer hold use to me.
units.displayText: But this time is different. I have the last piece of the puzzle. You no longer hold use to me.

spans.text: But this time is different. I have the last piece of the puzzle. You no longer hold use to me.

units.rawText: <cmdr>, you'll die all alone, an eternal damnation awaiting you.
units.displayText: {교수}, you'll die all alone, an eternal damnation awaiting you.

spans.text: , you'll die all alone, an eternal damnation awaiting you.

units.rawText: No, I won't let you do that.
units.displayText: No, I won't let you do that.

spans.text: No, I won't let you do that.

units.rawText: A double slash strikes from the flank, forcing Eosphorus back from its sheer force. As the mist clears, the two who had left reappear before me.
units.displayText: A double slash strikes from the flank, forcing Eosphorus back from its sheer force. As the mist clears, the two who had left reappear before me.

spans.text: A double slash strikes from the flank, forcing Eosphorus back from its sheer force. As the mist clears, the two who had left reappear before me.

units.rawText: I'm sorry, Professor. I'm a little bit late.
units.displayText: I'm sorry, Professor. I'm a little bit late.

spans.text: I'm sorry, Professor. I'm a little bit late.

units.rawText: It's fine.
units.displayText: It's fine.

spans.text: It's fine.

units.rawText: ...Persicaria, did you say your goodbyes?
units.displayText: ...Persicaria, did you say your goodbyes?

spans.text: ...Persicaria, did you say your goodbyes?

units.rawText: ...Yes.
units.displayText: ...Yes.

spans.text: ...Yes.

units.rawText: ...Even that move didn't work?
units.displayText: ...Even that move didn't work?

spans.text: ...Even that move didn't work?

units.rawText: Looks like you've become a worthy wielder of that sword, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Looks like you've become a worthy wielder of that sword, Persicaria.

spans.text: Looks like you've become a worthy wielder of that sword, Persicaria.

units.rawText: ...Because I've always been watching you closely, even now.
units.displayText: ...Because I've always been watching you closely, even now.

spans.text: ...Because I've always been watching you closely, even now.

units.rawText: Same goes for me. But you're no longer the one I'm familiar with.
units.displayText: Same goes for me. But you're no longer the one I'm familiar with.

spans.text: Same goes for me. But you're no longer the one I'm familiar with.

units.rawText: Do it.
units.displayText: Do it.

spans.text: Do it.

units.rawText: I am the inheritor of your will, your determination.
units.displayText: I am the inheritor of your will, your determination.

spans.text: I am the inheritor of your will, your determination.

units.rawText: Operands converge, igniting a bright orange flame at the sword's tip, like a miniature sun driving away the darkness.
units.displayText: Operands converge, igniting a bright orange flame at the sword's tip, like a miniature sun driving away the darkness.

spans.text: Operands converge, igniting a bright orange flame at the sword's tip, like a miniature sun driving away the darkness.

units.rawText: Without hesitation, Persicaria moves. She swings the blade with swiftness unparalleled, following all the way through to behind where Sol stood.
units.displayText: Without hesitation, Persicaria moves. She swings the blade with swiftness unparalleled, following all the way through to behind where Sol stood.

spans.text: Without hesitation, Persicaria moves. She swings the blade with swiftness unparalleled, following all the way through to behind where Sol stood.

units.rawText: The longsword is now sheathed. The replicator's core has been shattered in a flash, reducing into nothing but operands and dissolving wistfully into the air.
units.displayText: The longsword is now sheathed. The replicator's core has been shattered in a flash, reducing into nothing but operands and dissolving wistfully into the air.

spans.text: The longsword is now sheathed. The replicator's core has been shattered in a flash, reducing into nothing but operands and dissolving wistfully into the air.

units.rawText: What a beautiful strike...
units.displayText: What a beautiful strike...

spans.text: What a beautiful strike...

units.rawText: Persicaria doesn't respond, but only closes her eyelids, looking at Sol on the ground in silence.
units.displayText: Persicaria doesn't respond, but only closes her eyelids, looking at Sol on the ground in silence.

spans.text: Persicaria doesn't respond, but only closes her eyelids, looking at Sol on the ground in silence.

units.rawText: The mirage in front of her extends its hand, trying to touch her, but eventually, it closes its eyes with a soft smile, drawing back its fingertips to form a thumbs-up.
units.displayText: The mirage in front of her extends its hand, trying to touch her, but eventually, it closes its eyes with a soft smile, drawing back its fingertips to form a thumbs-up.

spans.text: The mirage in front of her extends its hand, trying to touch her, but eventually, it closes its eyes with a soft smile, drawing back its fingertips to form a thumbs-up.

units.rawText: Great job, Persicaria.
units.displayText: Great job, Persicaria.

spans.text: Great job, Persicaria.

units.rawText: You really are a perfect replica, copying all these troublesome details.
units.displayText: You really are a perfect replica, copying all these troublesome details.

spans.text: You really are a perfect replica, copying all these troublesome details.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: The wind swallows Persicaria's words, but the figure lying on the ground reads her lips and responds with a radiant smile.
units.displayText: The wind swallows Persicaria's words, but the figure lying on the ground reads her lips and responds with a radiant smile.

spans.text: The wind swallows Persicaria's words, but the figure lying on the ground reads her lips and responds with a radiant smile.

units.rawText: We will.
units.displayText: We will.

spans.text: We will.

units.rawText: The orange figure disperses with the wind, disappearing into the sunset.
units.displayText: The orange figure disperses with the wind, disappearing into the sunset.

spans.text: The orange figure disperses with the wind, disappearing into the sunset.

units.rawText: This time, I managed to say a proper goodbye.
units.displayText: This time, I managed to say a proper goodbye.

spans.text: This time, I managed to say a proper goodbye.

units.rawText: I see. I'm glad you did.
units.displayText: I see. I'm glad you did.

spans.text: I see. I'm glad you did.

units.rawText: Cough, cough... Hng...
units.displayText: Cough, cough... Hng...

spans.text: Cough, cough... Hng...

units.rawText: Sangoma, are you holding up?
units.displayText: Sangoma, are you holding up?

spans.text: Sangoma, are you holding up?

units.rawText: This old body is really at its limit. These old bones can't hold on for much longer...
units.displayText: This old body is really at its limit. These old bones can't hold on for much longer...

spans.text: This old body is really at its limit. These old bones can't hold on for much longer...

units.rawText: I can only support you from a less offensive position, I can't afford to face him directly any longer... The rest is on you now, Persicaria.
units.displayText: I can only support you from a less offensive position, I can't afford to face him directly any longer... The rest is on you now, Persicaria.

spans.text: I can only support you from a less offensive position, I can't afford to face him directly any longer... The rest is on you now, Persicaria.

units.rawText: No problem. I'll take on the role of the main attacker.
units.displayText: No problem. I'll take on the role of the main attacker.

spans.text: No problem. I'll take on the role of the main attacker.

units.rawText: The operand-infused longsword is once again in Persicaria's hand.
units.displayText: The operand-infused longsword is once again in Persicaria's hand.

spans.text: The operand-infused longsword is once again in Persicaria's hand.

units.rawText: This time, I won't allow him to take anything away from me.
units.displayText: This time, I won't allow him to take anything away from me.

spans.text: This time, I won't allow him to take anything away from me.

units.rawText: Professor. I await your orders.
units.displayText: Professor. I await your orders.

spans.text: Professor. I await your orders.

units.rawText: Got it.
units.displayText: Got it.

spans.text: Got it.

units.rawText: You done with the chitchat?
units.displayText: You done with the chitchat?

spans.text: You done with the chitchat?

units.rawText: BOOM—
units.displayText: BOOM—

spans.text: BOOM—

units.rawText: The sudden attack disrupts our conversation. The two clash with the stardust that fall from the sky, taking me to a safe area with the help of the dust clouds left in their wake.
units.displayText: The sudden attack disrupts our conversation. The two clash with the stardust that fall from the sky, taking me to a safe area with the help of the dust clouds left in their wake.

spans.text: The sudden attack disrupts our conversation. The two clash with the stardust that fall from the sky, taking me to a safe area with the help of the dust clouds left in their wake.

units.rawText: In an instant, Sangoma's giant scythe crashes forward, only to be intercepted by the blades in Eosphorus' hands. Sparks fly as their weapons clash, and from the flank, Persicaria's strike is deflected by his operand shield.
units.displayText: In an instant, Sangoma's giant scythe crashes forward, only to be intercepted by the blades in Eosphorus' hands. Sparks fly as their weapons clash, and from the flank, Persicaria's strike is deflected by his operand shield.

spans.text: In an instant, Sangoma's giant scythe crashes forward, only to be intercepted by the blades in Eosphorus' hands. Sparks fly as their weapons clash, and from the flank, Persicaria's strike is deflected by his operand shield.

units.rawText: Is that all you've got?
units.displayText: Is that all you've got?

spans.text: Is that all you've got?

units.rawText: To underestimate another is a bad habit.
units.displayText: To underestimate another is a bad habit.

spans.text: To underestimate another is a bad habit.

units.rawText: Though their attacks are deflected, their resolve remains unshaken. They press forward, unleashing a series of assaults and closing the gap, denying Eosphorus the distance to release another meteor strike.
units.displayText: Though their attacks are deflected, their resolve remains unshaken. They press forward, unleashing a series of assaults and closing the gap, denying Eosphorus the distance to release another meteor strike.

spans.text: Though their attacks are deflected, their resolve remains unshaken. They press forward, unleashing a series of assaults and closing the gap, denying Eosphorus the distance to release another meteor strike.

units.rawText: While they're pressing against Eosphorus, their battle positions are craftily swapped without noticing.
units.displayText: While they're pressing against Eosphorus, their battle positions are craftily swapped without noticing.

spans.text: While they're pressing against Eosphorus, their battle positions are craftily swapped without noticing.

units.rawText: Persicaria faces Eosphorus upfront, clashing with her sheer strength, while Sangoma runs her scythe's blade through the shield from the flank, cutting through.
units.displayText: Persicaria faces Eosphorus upfront, clashing with her sheer strength, while Sangoma runs her scythe's blade through the shield from the flank, cutting through.

spans.text: Persicaria faces Eosphorus upfront, clashing with her sheer strength, while Sangoma runs her scythe's blade through the shield from the flank, cutting through.

units.rawText: As Eosphorus activates the second layer of his shield to defend, the two swap to their fists and legs, blowing him away with the combined force of a punch and a kick.
units.displayText: As Eosphorus activates the second layer of his shield to defend, the two swap to their fists and legs, blowing him away with the combined force of a punch and a kick.

spans.text: As Eosphorus activates the second layer of his shield to defend, the two swap to their fists and legs, blowing him away with the combined force of a punch and a kick.

units.rawText: The figure who had been pushed back by that strike, clad in clothes so white softly dusts off his sleeves, showing no trace of mercy in his expression.
units.displayText: The figure who had been pushed back by that strike, clad in clothes so white softly dusts off his sleeves, showing no trace of mercy in his expression.

spans.text: The figure who had been pushed back by that strike, clad in clothes so white softly dusts off his sleeves, showing no trace of mercy in his expression.

units.rawText: Is this how you seek to deplete my operands?
units.displayText: Is this how you seek to deplete my operands?

spans.text: Is this how you seek to deplete my operands?

units.rawText: Good thinking, but your attacks are futile.
units.displayText: Good thinking, but your attacks are futile.

spans.text: Good thinking, but your attacks are futile.

units.rawText: The two exchange glances, reverse-gripping their weapons simultaneously.
units.displayText: The two exchange glances, reverse-gripping their weapons simultaneously.

spans.text: The two exchange glances, reverse-gripping their weapons simultaneously.

units.rawText: ...What?
units.displayText: ...What?

spans.text: ...What?

units.rawText: Before he can react, the two throw their weapons deftly at Eosphorus. Taking advantage of the instant before Eosphorus activates his shield, Persicaria and Sangoma both grab the other's weapon and strike.
units.displayText: Before he can react, the two throw their weapons deftly at Eosphorus. Taking advantage of the instant before Eosphorus activates his shield, Persicaria and Sangoma both grab the other's weapon and strike.

spans.text: Before he can react, the two throw their weapons deftly at Eosphorus. Taking advantage of the instant before Eosphorus activates his shield, Persicaria and Sangoma both grab the other's weapon and strike.

units.rawText: The next moment, dark-red operands scatter through the air. As he steps back to regain his balance, the two have returned their weapons to one another seamlessly.
units.displayText: The next moment, dark-red operands scatter through the air. As he steps back to regain his balance, the two have returned their weapons to one another seamlessly.

spans.text: The next moment, dark-red operands scatter through the air. As he steps back to regain his balance, the two have returned their weapons to one another seamlessly.

units.rawText: Ah, it feels pretty good to swing a sword from time to time~
units.displayText: Ah, it feels pretty good to swing a sword from time to time~

spans.text: Ah, it feels pretty good to swing a sword from time to time~

units.rawText: That scythe is heavier than I thought... but its power is indeed formidable.
units.displayText: That scythe is heavier than I thought... but its power is indeed formidable.

spans.text: That scythe is heavier than I thought... but its power is indeed formidable.

units.rawText: So then, imposter. Are our attacks as futile as you say?
units.displayText: So then, imposter. Are our attacks as futile as you say?

spans.text: So then, imposter. Are our attacks as futile as you say?

units.rawText: ...Your fates are sealed, why do you still struggle?
units.displayText: ...Your fates are sealed, why do you still struggle?

spans.text: ...Your fates are sealed, why do you still struggle?

units.rawText: ...What a stupid question.
units.displayText: ...What a stupid question.

spans.text: ...What a stupid question.

units.rawText: Yeah, the real deal wouldn't be this talkative.
units.displayText: Yeah, the real deal wouldn't be this talkative.

spans.text: Yeah, the real deal wouldn't be this talkative.

units.rawText: As if irritated, Eosphorus calls down a rain of meteors toward the two.
units.displayText: As if irritated, Eosphorus calls down a rain of meteors toward the two.

spans.text: As if irritated, Eosphorus calls down a rain of meteors toward the two.

units.rawText: Persicaria and Sangoma slash at the meteors non-stop. Though they try their best, this long, drawn out battle has depleted most of their operands.
units.displayText: Persicaria and Sangoma slash at the meteors non-stop. Though they try their best, this long, drawn out battle has depleted most of their operands.

spans.text: Persicaria and Sangoma slash at the meteors non-stop. Though they try their best, this long, drawn out battle has depleted most of their operands.

units.rawText: Hah... Hah... It's been quite a while since I've had to work every joint and muscle of mine...
units.displayText: Hah... Hah... It's been quite a while since I've had to work every joint and muscle of mine...

spans.text: Hah... Hah... It's been quite a while since I've had to work every joint and muscle of mine...

units.rawText: ...You still holding up?
units.displayText: ...You still holding up?

spans.text: ...You still holding up?

units.rawText: This kind of battle is too much for an old model like me...
units.displayText: This kind of battle is too much for an old model like me...

spans.text: This kind of battle is too much for an old model like me...

units.rawText: I don't know of any old models that can fight like you...
units.displayText: I don't know of any old models that can fight like you...

spans.text: I don't know of any old models that can fight like you...

units.rawText: Pfft... Didn't think you'd have the nerves to make a jest...
units.displayText: Pfft... Didn't think you'd have the nerves to make a jest...

spans.text: Pfft... Didn't think you'd have the nerves to make a jest...

units.rawText: Sangoma, I still have many questions that I want to ask you... Whether it's about Professor, or about you.
units.displayText: Sangoma, I still have many questions that I want to ask you... Whether it's about Professor, or about you.

spans.text: Sangoma, I still have many questions that I want to ask you... Whether it's about Professor, or about you.

units.rawText: Okay... Fine, I'll answer you later.
units.displayText: Okay... Fine, I'll answer you later.

spans.text: Okay... Fine, I'll answer you later.

units.rawText: Their operands should be running out too after that last attack.
units.displayText: Their operands should be running out too after that last attack.

spans.text: Their operands should be running out too after that last attack.

units.rawText: Indeed. Regardless, the next attack will be our last.
units.displayText: Indeed. Regardless, the next attack will be our last.

spans.text: Indeed. Regardless, the next attack will be our last.

units.rawText: The two stop talking, slashing at Eosphorus with their operands and weapons.
units.displayText: The two stop talking, slashing at Eosphorus with their operands and weapons.

spans.text: The two stop talking, slashing at Eosphorus with their operands and weapons.

units.rawText: I won't fall for the same trick.
units.displayText: I won't fall for the same trick.

spans.text: I won't fall for the same trick.

units.rawText: As his operands increase in output, his shield activates, a symbol of despair which renders all of their attacks futile.
units.displayText: As his operands increase in output, his shield activates, a symbol of despair which renders all of their attacks futile.

spans.text: As his operands increase in output, his shield activates, a symbol of despair which renders all of their attacks futile.

units.rawText: In this moment, a tiny crackling sound pierces the battlefield's tranquility. Before Eosphorus can react, the attack has fractured the corner of his shield.
units.displayText: In this moment, a tiny crackling sound pierces the battlefield's tranquility. Before Eosphorus can react, the attack has fractured the corner of his shield.

spans.text: In this moment, a tiny crackling sound pierces the battlefield's tranquility. Before Eosphorus can react, the attack has fractured the corner of his shield.

units.rawText: <size=40>Again!</size>
units.displayText: Again!

spans.text: Again!

units.rawText: <size=40>Got it!</size>
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: A flurry of attacks surges toward the crack.
units.displayText: A flurry of attacks surges toward the crack.

spans.text: A flurry of attacks surges toward the crack.

units.rawText: The operand shield crumbles under the heavy pressure, but Eosphorus endures, letting their strikes impale his arms to stop them in their tracks.
units.displayText: The operand shield crumbles under the heavy pressure, but Eosphorus endures, letting their strikes impale his arms to stop them in their tracks.

spans.text: The operand shield crumbles under the heavy pressure, but Eosphorus endures, letting their strikes impale his arms to stop them in their tracks.

units.rawText: You used all of your remaining operands on this attack...
units.displayText: You used all of your remaining operands on this attack...

spans.text: You used all of your remaining operands on this attack...

units.rawText: A pitiful effort. That alone is not enough to defeat me.
units.displayText: A pitiful effort. That alone is not enough to defeat me.

spans.text: A pitiful effort. That alone is not enough to defeat me.

units.rawText: The two, hearing his words, did not despair. Instead, they grasp their weapons ever tighter.
units.displayText: The two, hearing his words, did not despair. Instead, they grasp their weapons ever tighter.

spans.text: The two, hearing his words, did not despair. Instead, they grasp their weapons ever tighter.

units.rawText: We never expected that attack to do any real damage to you in the first place.
units.displayText: We never expected that attack to do any real damage to you in the first place.

spans.text: We never expected that attack to do any real damage to you in the first place.

units.rawText: ...All we did was to force you into this position to catch you by surprise.
units.displayText: ...All we did was to force you into this position to catch you by surprise.

spans.text: ...All we did was to force you into this position to catch you by surprise.

units.rawText: Professor!
units.displayText: Professor!

spans.text: Professor!

units.rawText: Eosphorus subconsciously looks toward his blind spot, but he's a step too late.
units.displayText: Eosphorus subconsciously looks toward his blind spot, but he's a step too late.

spans.text: Eosphorus subconsciously looks toward his blind spot, but he's a step too late.

units.rawText: Bang—
units.displayText: Bang—

spans.text: Bang—

units.rawText: The bullet precisely hits his core where a crack emerges, staggering him for an instant.
units.displayText: The bullet precisely hits his core where a crack emerges, staggering him for an instant.

spans.text: The bullet precisely hits his core where a crack emerges, staggering him for an instant.

units.rawText: <size=60>Go! Persicaria!</size>
units.displayText: Go! Persicaria!

spans.text: Go! Persicaria!

units.rawText: <size=60>AAAAHHHH!</size>
units.displayText: AAAAHHHH!

spans.text: AAAAHHHH!

units.rawText: In a blinding blaze of steel, Persicaria's blade strikes true, shattering Eosphorus' core with a decisive blow.
units.displayText: In a blinding blaze of steel, Persicaria's blade strikes true, shattering Eosphorus' core with a decisive blow.

spans.text: In a blinding blaze of steel, Persicaria's blade strikes true, shattering Eosphorus' core with a decisive blow.

units.rawText: Eosphorus' form collapses, returning to a purple liquid that spreads across the earth, with only a pair of eyes remaining in the puddle.
units.displayText: Eosphorus' form collapses, returning to a purple liquid that spreads across the earth, with only a pair of eyes remaining in the puddle.

spans.text: Eosphorus' form collapses, returning to a purple liquid that spreads across the earth, with only a pair of eyes remaining in the puddle.

units.rawText: Those golden pupils, always so cold and tyrannical, mock us with their gaze... until they eventually expire.
units.displayText: Those golden pupils, always so cold and tyrannical, mock us with their gaze... until they eventually expire.

spans.text: Those golden pupils, always so cold and tyrannical, mock us with their gaze... until they eventually expire.
